channel.title: Personal Ledger
channel.description: Updates for Personal Ledger on Windows.

item.title: Version 1.0.2
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.2

  • A new look: Personal Ledger has its own icon, and a tidier top bar with your name beside your picture.
  • New journal entries suggest the account you usually use on the other side, and list your most-used accounts first.
  • Entries with a rate now show what you entered, the rate, and the amount posted, with clearly named columns.
  • Click any column heading to sort a table: the account ledger, journal entries, trial balance and activity log.
  • After updating, your desktop shortcut and taskbar pin show the new icon straight away.
